'''Outpost Bolym''' was an outpost owned by [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] near the [[Juran Pass]] coming from the [[Kaamos Territory]]. In this outpost, were stationed Lord [[Urduun]], Major [[Pharoth]] and [[Stanel Andaren Thul]].
